sourceIssues.issue: The instruction asks to replace stressed pronouns, but the supplied completed sentences already contain unstressed pronouns. New practice names a person explicitly before requesting one pronoun.

provenance: All practice, scenes, examples and programme responses are original changed-detail companion material. All three answer-key pages remain reference-only; puzzle answers and the final code are not published. Vocabulary phrases are labelled original topic extensions.
remainingSourceGaps: This review uses a retained three-page LibreOffice render; Word or another PDF export may paginate differently.
The supplied completed puzzle, code clues and final code remain private source material.
The past, reflexive and comparison foundations are reused rather than duplicated as new grammar units.
The new sembrare/mancare lesson is limited to present-tense nominal-subject patterns; it is not a complete course on either verb.
